title: Human–AI Communication (HA‑C): Transforming the Role of Technology in Human Interaction
core_idea: A conceptual narrative review that examines the shift from computer-mediated communication to AI-mediated communication and develops a Human–AI Communication (HA‑C) framework featuring a four-level hierarchical model of AI agency (reactive, adaptive, proactive, strategic) and the notion of distributed agency, detailing mechanisms such as context analysis, intent recognition, response generation, and continuous evaluation while identifying key ethical and regulatory challenges.
tldr: Explores how AI evolves from a passive tool to active communication agents, proposes a four-level HA‑C agency framework and distributed-agency concept, and highlights ethical and regulatory issues to consider.
